research_question: Within species sharing the same exact six-anthocyanidin presence/absence signature, does phylogenetic proximity predict similarity of pathway-wide flower-petal gene expression?

temporal_order.source_data: Already public and prior CHUN Petunieae analyses outcome-exposed
temporal_order.specific_new_primary_statistic: Protocol frozen before computing current conditional gene-expression distance correlation

frame.cohort_selection: Use the EXACT existing 47-tip frozen biochemical-resolution profile: after excluding outgroup, discard all taxa in six-bit anthocyanidin fine states with fewer than five members. No new eligibility thresholds.
frame.fine_presence_rule: each compound >0 is present; zero is absent; fine state is the 6-bit vector in fixed order

primary.transform: log1p of TPM10K raw value; each column z-scored among frozen 47 tips (population std ddof=0); zero-variance columns assigned zero vector, not outcome-selected for deletion
primary.pair_universe: unordered pairs of retained species with identical six-bit fine anthocyanidin presence signature; pairs cannot cross fine groups
primary.tree_score: patristic distance on the frozen 11genestre dated tree; rank Spearman is invariant to the division by twice tree height, so no absolute time interpretation
primary.expression_distance: Euclidean RMS across all 21 fixed z-scored log1p expression columns, each species retains its complete multigene vector
primary.estimand: Spearman rho between patristic distance and expression RMS distance among exactly same-fine-status unordered taxon pairs
primary.sign_prediction: rho > 0, i.e. expression vectors are more similar at shorter phylogenetic separation even when fine compound presence/absence state is identical
primary.conditional_null: Permute entire 21-gene expression vectors among tip labels strictly WITHIN each exact six-bit pigment signature; hold tree distances, six-bit labels, and all cross-gene covariance intact
primary.monte_carlo_p: (1 + number of permuted rho >= observed rho)/(10000)
primary.negative_decision: otherwise, report NOT_SUPPORTED without redefining gene list, fine states or percentile cutoffs
primary.pair_dependency: Pairs are not treated as independent observations; all inference uses taxon-label permutations conditional on fine-state membership

secondary.pigment_transform: log1p(100*x) mass-fraction units, then zscore across same 47 taxa and RMS pair distance
secondary.statistic: Spearman rho between patristic distance and pigment concentration RMS among EXACT same-fine pairs, with 9999 within-fine whole-profile permutations using seed 20261009
secondary.interpretation: Concentration-level within-state memory; exploratory and no claim of different persistence rate versus gene-expression module from raw rho difference alone
secondary.leave_one_tip_out: Descriptive sign stability for primary statistic across each of 47 leave-one-tip-out samples; no bootstrap pair-independence assumptions

integration_promotion_rule.if_primary_positive: Report a retrospective same-tree hidden regulatory-history result and keep it explicitly one-radiation; the seven-case mechanisms and 32-clade temporal atlas are still not directly linked across radiations
integration_promotion_rule.if_primary_nonpositive: Do not hide failure; report source-specific lack of measurable pathway-wide residual gene-expression memory under the fixed estimator
integration_promotion_rule.journal_claim: Not enough to claim that molecular mechanism variation causes temporal colour-memory decay; at least another independent, same-taxa/source matched radiation is required to generalize
